source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: A psychic ability. When your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) starts, pick one enemy unit this **PSYKER** model can see. For the rest of that phase, attacks made by models in this unit against the picked unit add 1 to their [Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls).
